grading_system.evidence: Total number of core credits required: 23. Total number of areas in which to demonstrate proficiency: 8 (Including demonstration of proficiency in Montpelier High School's 8 Learning Expectations)

schedule.evidence: Students can take a '4th block class both Green and White days'. The catalog implies four blocks a day across Green and White days (4 blocks x 2 day types = 8 courses at once); the catalog does not state this count directly.

credit_definition.text: Courses are listed in credits per semester or per year. A semester course is 0.5 credit and a full-year course is 1 credit. Requirements are stated in credits and in proficiency areas.

course_load.evidence: Not stated in the Program of Studies text.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Catalog states 23 core credits and no conversion is needed (credits are standard units, 0.5 per semester course). Areas: English Language Arts 4, Math 3, Science 3, Global Citizenship 3, Visual & Performing Arts 1, PE 1.5, Health 0.5, plus 7 additional choice credits (p.4). Proficiency must be demonstrated in each area and in all 8 Learning Expectations (including Habits for Success/Preparedness).

notes: Catalog is the 2026-27 Program of Studies. Graduation is proficiency-based with a 23-credit core total plus 7 additional choice credits (p.4). Learning Expectations (transferable skills) are required for graduation and reported as a running average in PowerSchool (p.4-5); LE 6.1 Habits of Success: Preparedness is graded separately. Courses use proficiency indicators (p.4). The catalog gives no numeric proficiency scale. Schedule uses Green and White days with a 4th block on both (p.62); the number of blocks per day is inferred from that wording. Transportation to CVCC leaves at 8:00 AM for students attending the career center (p.62). Senior Capstone is listed under Flexible Pathways (p.59-60).
